name: C-Skip
instructions: Stand tall and begin a rhythmic skip, swinging the opposite arm as you move forward.
Drive one thigh up to about hip height with the ankle dorsiflexed, as in an A-Skip.
From the top, cycle the lower leg so the heel pulls under the hip in a paw-back, then strike the ground under the body.
Do not sweep the foot out in front as in a B-Skip; keep the recovery tight and under the hip.
Stay tall through the torso and alternate legs for the set time.
